annual_capacity_allocation.basis: When annual requested volume exceeds the active contract/physical limit, every available order remains visible and its feasible part is scaled by one transparent annual factor.

demand_service_priority.basis: Critical demand is served before non-critical demand when physical inventory is insufficient.

earth_new_operational_delivery_lag_month.basis: The official lead time is used for preparation and commissioning; no second post-commission transport lag is specified.

earth_new_project_lead_months.basis: Conservative upper endpoint of the official 18-24 month CASE_INPUT range.

lunar_isru_delivery_lead_months.basis: Conservative upper endpoint of the official 1-2 month CASE_INPUT range after commissioning.

monthly_demand_allocation.basis: Annual demand is divided equally across twelve model months.

monthly_event_order.basis: A deterministic within-month convention is required because the official case supplies annual demand and monthly/weekly lead-time inputs but no intra-month timestamps.

partial_year_price_override.basis: Each physical order is charged at its order-month price. TOP-only volume has no order month and is charged at the equal-capacity time-weighted rate over active contract months.

pre_horizon_availability_semantics.basis: A contract/order may be placed before the source service start, but physical delivery cannot precede source commissioning/availability.

pre_horizon_financial_year.basis: The implementation requirement assigns all preparatory acquisition costs to the first model financial year.

real_discount_rate.basis: Demonstration real rate; the team must justify it before final submission.

storage_average_method.basis: Monthly holding cost uses the mean of opening and closing physical inventory.

week_to_model_month_conversion.basis: Emergency six-week lead time is converted to ceil(42 / (365/12)) = 2 model months.
